correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the bijection from a word to the nondecreasing list x of numbers of zeros preceding each one. Each one contributes x to 01 and x(a−x) to 010, so fixed t makes the problem the extremization of sum(x²) on a bounded integer simplex. Smoothing a pair differing by at least 2 strictly decreases the sum of squares; the only possible minimizer has b−r entries q and r entries q+1. Transferring one unit from a smaller positive interior entry to a larger interior entry strictly increases the sum of squares; the only possible maximizer has floor(t/a) entries a and at most one residual interior part. Sorting changes neither objective nor feasibility; each forced multiset corresponds to one word. The latter construction also covers every t including endpoints and degenerate a=1 or b=1. Gap multiplicities are independent nonnegative integers before fixing b,t, so their geometric series prove the joint product coefficientwise. Reducing x² modulo 2 yields the parity law; the balanced half-area example has the claimed unbounded difference. The supporting scripts and recorded outputs check finite grids only: the positional and partition checks report 833 and 3125 fibers, respectively; the all-parameter result follows from the proof.

originality.rationale: The distinct result supported by the available evidence is the exact two-sided classwise count problem and its unique extremizers, with a joint 01/010 enumerator. The partition representation, quadratic gap weights, and convex optimization technique are not new. The originality judgment rests on the fixed-area refinement and sharp all-fiber theorem, not on re-marking independent gaps alone.
residual_risks: The motivating paper arXiv:2610.06717 and the decisive exact passages from the two nearest indexed records were not independently recovered; the comparisons are limited to the described statements.

The optimization is a specialization of standard strict convexity/majorization, and the gap product uses an established representation; no claim of new general optimization or of an explicit rule for gaps in the attainable spectrum.

value.rationale: The 2-binomial classes are a natural information-loss setting. Knowing exactly what alternating triple multiplicity that data permits, and which words realize the ends, gives a sharp and usable measure of information loss. The joint enumerator also answers multiplicity queries beyond presence, while the half-area family quantifies an unbounded spread. The value is in the complete fixed-area answer and uniqueness, not the classical exchange moves or a few computed examples.
